A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoG framework. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison; v2 retains Appendices A–J and adds Appendix K.

before.justification: v1 reports original CoG benchmark results, component ablations, efficiency measurements, sensitivity analyses, and evaluation on Wikidata.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and additionally reports F1 results and a System 2 Only ablation.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the blueprint construction, copy–adapt retrieval, reranking, pruning, refinement procedures, and prompts. The added offline-cost clarification and blueprint-failure discussion do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CWQ, WebQSP, and GrailQA on Freebase, plus mapped CWQ/WebQSP questions on Wikidata in Appendix I. Query-type and generalization coverage remain unchanged; Appendix K introduces no evaluated test scenario.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds the evaluated comparator 'w/o Blueprint Guidance (System 2 Only).' External baseline membership in the benchmark, efficiency, and Wikidata comparisons is unchanged. Newly discussed GCR is not an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 adds F1 alongside Hits@1 for CWQ/WebQSP, and Section 4.3 introduces a control removing all blueprint guidance. Existing dataset splits, backbone configurations, generation settings, and sensitivity protocols are retained.

E4.justification: The new System 2 Only ablation tests refinement without any blueprint guidance, extending v1's narrower adaptation and reranking removals. Existing sensitivity, error-attribution, Wikidata, and case analyses remain. Appendix K supplies discussion rather than a new empirical failure analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added results retain the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 substantially extends reported evidence with answer-set F1 across two benchmarks and three CoG backbones; GPT-4 CoG scores 69.2/75.5 versus PoG's 42.1/59.8 on CWQ/WebQSP. Table 3 adds System 2 Only scores of 61.5/82.2/76.4. UniKGQA's WebQSP Hits@1 changes from 79.1 to 77.2. Existing CoG Hits@1, efficiency, and other appendix results are retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations (1)–(6), alignment constraints, and scoring formulation are unchanged. Neither the added F1 description nor Appendix K introduces a formal derivation, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: The conclusion adds an explicit claim of comprehensive answer-set retrieval, supported by the newly reported F1 results. The central training-free, dual-process contribution and claims concerning accuracy, efficiency, and generalization remain.

C2.justification: Appendix K newly asserts that mismatched blueprints trigger overrides and backtracking, incur only bounded overhead, and preserve answer fidelity—a substantial extension of v1's recovery interpretation without a direct mismatch experiment. v2 also interprets refinement's independent contribution and adds discussion of linear blueprints' expressiveness versus tree-structured constraints.

D1.justification: v2 adds a CoG repository link, identifies specific backbones for several Table 1 entries, and states that baseline results come from original papers. Section 3.1 explicitly clarifies training-set-only offline construction without LLM API calls. Existing hardware, hyperparameters, prompts, and SPARQL templates remain.

R1.justification: Section 5 substantially refocuses positioning around PoG's online planning versus GCR's hard KG-trie constraints. It adds literature on temporal/table QA and knowledge grounding, while removing G-Retriever, KnowGPT, and Exemplar-guided Planning citations. Consolidating duplicate Brown references is only bibliographic cleanup.

P1.justification: Paragraph-level editing affects the results, ablations, conclusion, limitations, and baseline descriptions. v2 adds acknowledgements, Appendix K, and corresponding-author information. The main section sequence and extensive method and appendix text remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 becomes a full-width table with Hits@1/F1 subcolumns and an expanded caption; Table 3 adds a row and uses smaller text. Figure 8 corrects 'Angelina Jolie' to 'Kevin Hart.' Other figures are retained, with relocation and page reflow rather than new visual analyses.

improvement.justification: F1 reporting addresses answer-set completeness, and the full-guidance ablation better isolates the two systems' contributions. The repository link and backbone labels improve transparency. These provide a limited net improvement, tempered by Appendix K's untested assurance that blueprint mismatches preserve answer fidelity.
